sharedRules.scope: NEW selections in this return are spell-local proposed authorship for the eight named identities only. Original cards, every classAccess row, inherited scoped interfaces and previous acceptance boundaries are retained. The catalog source-status is not a runtime grant. A lawful hypothetical authored actor is not proof of a campaign character, equipment inventory, soul, plane or observed execution.
sharedRules.casting: KEEP rank9, minimum class level17, base26RP, Action and V/S/F on each native route. Wizard alone has Astral Shell through Illusion. Druid/Mage/Wizard have the three Transmutation identities. The four Abjuration identities retain only their actual native Cleric/Druid/Mage/Wizard routes. Use each complete native record below as controlling access. No copied-feat or source label supplies ordinary preparation. Require acquired repertoire, legal rank, remaining Action, audible V, usable S hand and actual accessible class focus F. No legal target means no commitment. Once a legal cast begins, pay26 plus actual pre-cast Dissonance surcharge and printed adjustments, commit Action/components/cadence, open the cast-time interruption window, then resolve. A hidden-invalid placement, counter, or later failed prerequisite refunds nothing. No generic Overcast or slot engine.
sharedRules.cadence: Ordinary rank9 base Dissonance2; first distinct prepared Wizard matrix family in this encounter has0 BASE only. A repeated family still has ordinary base2 and consecutive Refrain1/2/3 capped3. Different names reset consecutive Refrain but do not restore a family exemption. Read pre-cast Dissonance for the price surcharge and ordinary limit+6 block. Track cast histories before counters. Class Wizard Dispel is acquired at its real gate, rank3, printed3RP, Action60ft, recharge2; against rank9 INT+PB versus19. Class Counterspell is automatic at2, rank1,3RP, Reaction60ft, recharge2, INT+PB versus28 against these rank9 casts. Neither is mapped to rank5 Greater Dispel. Current accepted Greater Dispel is a separate source and is not assumed acquired.
sharedRules.geometry: Declare actual whole3D occupied bodies, anchors, range witness and unobstructed line of effect. Targeted buffs require one actually willing, perceived creature, including self, at the native range:120ft except Body to Void actual Touch; Divine Shield has its separate30ft snapshot. Touch means actual accessible contact, not a ranged substitute. Consent is a fixture fact, never a faction/alignment oracle. No hidden roster, equipment, anatomy or destination is inferred from a name. Fix selections before hidden resolution; the audit state is not player knowledge.
sharedRules.clocks: NEW explicit finite duration: Absolute Immunity, Astral Shell, Divine Shield, Elemental Shell and Timeless Form last60 elapsed seconds from manifestation. Body to Void uses the original caster third future regular START, excluding a start already underway; outside initiative it uses application+18sec. Eternal Protection is until actual dispel, without a finite deadline. Sphere uses its own concentration60sec. Equality expires before a later payload request. Regular starts/ends, budgets, recharge, death saves, Ready and attached phases are independent of spell events. Extra Actions/turns do not tick ordinary regular clocks. Mode changes and save/load preserve original anchors, IDs, history, RNG, remaining resources and deadlines. No menu, pause label or elapsed-time conversion grants recovery or a turn.
sharedRules.ready: KEEP ordinary Ready: preparation spends the Action and spell costs, performs components/cadence once, and uses concentration even for an otherwise nonconcentration ward. One held Ready expires before next own regular-start refresh. At a legal trigger, spend the remaining Reaction, choose/recheck actual target/area and manifest; duration starts there. No second cast/counter/cost occurs on release. Invalid or declined release consumes no Reaction and may await another trigger before the original Ready expiry. Replacing, expiry, lost concentration and countering preserve spent costs. Actual Slow Reaction prohibition can prevent release; Timeless Form does not recreate a spent Reaction.
sharedRules.defenseStages: KEEP distinct sources and predicates: strongest eligible flat damage reduction, then one resistance halving rounded down, actual immunity/prevention, then any permitted post-defense transfer, temporary HP and Core HP/Wound/concentration/lifecycle stages. Explicit bypasses control only their own stages. Warding Bond post-defense transfer skips a second mitigation/prevention stage and cannot be sent through these wards again. Direct HP payments, direct death, costs and source termination are not damage. Temporary HP never becomes normal HP; no defense resurrects. Positive damage-dependent hooks require the actual positive result. Prevented damage grants no Wound, kill, healing, RP or similar outcome reward.
sharedRules.conditions: KEEP CONDITIONS_PLAYTEST shared handling. An actual condition immunity prevents that named condition and its inherited component; it does not automatically prevent all parent conditions. Existing affected consequences are suppressed, with source records, severity, ownership and clocks retained. Resume only still-live consequences, without replaying dropped gear, concentration loss, spent Actions or one-time triggers. No disease, toxin, corruption, addiction or injury is cured by suppressing an associated condition. ZeroHP, Dead, damage history, sacrifice and costs remain real. Wound/Exhaustion/Unity track levels remain recorded; suppression affects their condition consequences, not a reversal of completed death or source history. Inactive historical Resonance Burn remains inactive, not a newly executable strain engine.
sharedRules.sourceLifetime: Finite buff sources are nonconcentration unless expressly stated. Caster death/rest, distance and scene unload alone do not end them. Dead recipients get no restored life or agency; retain source record until its real deadline or removal. Only actual source-specific endings apply. Independent overlapping Absolute/Astral/Divine/Timeless sources keep separate deadlines and nonstacking consequences. Elemental Shell and Body to Void have the explicit replacement rules below. Targeted dispel ends only the captured application; stale cleanup never deletes a newer source. A cast is not made divine-antimagic-proof by its name.
sharedRules.suppression: KEEP accepted Lesser Antimagic actual fixed10ft-radius/10ft-range, Action10RP,V/S/F,concentration60sec. Body-attached expressions are wholly unavailable while that body intersects. Clocks and custody continue, without queued damage, reflection, commands or refreshed wards on resumption. Instantaneous payload whose actual manifestation is suppressed produces no packet/root. A remote concentrating caster inside does not alone cancel an outside expression. Ending the target field by actual class Dispel ignores only that same field under AC5-ANTIMAGIC-IO-04; a second field may still suppress the operation. Null is not antimagic.
sharedRules.rebind: Current accepted Elemental Rebind is used only in its exact scope: Action13RP,60ft,V/S/F,CON save, one acid/cold/fire/lightning/thunder choice,5d10 with success half/no stripping. Failure suppresses actual selected-type resistances/immunities until target first future regular END, excluding an in-progress turn. It reaches the selected portion of Astral all-type resistance, Divine typed immunity, Eternal typed resistance and Elemental typed immunity. It does not remove Absolute independently defined all-damage prevention, condition defenses, flat DR, temporary HP, reflection or form permissions. Sources independently expiring during stripping do not return. Its own suppression temporarily releases still-live covered defenses with no damage replay.
sharedRules.informationAndQualification: Preserve source/access, physical-content, lifecycle and campaign-premise holds; do not invent a creature, acquired feature, geometry, item durability, oxygen budget, true identity, plane or soul. Full-state counterfactual fixtures expose information only to the auditor. Static integrity/replay and a semantic review are not runtime execution, human play, balance, cosmology, domain closure or release certification.
sharedRules.scalingAndResolution: No scaling, automatic upcast or additional RP mode is supplied. Legal willing ward/form establishment is automatic; no save/attack is invented for it. Opposed attacks, exact removal checks and third-party effects retain their own sourced resolution. These local selections do not grant new class access or preparation.

selectedRules.rule: Elemental Shell: NEW one willing target120ft/LoE, one element from acid,cold,fire,lightning,thunder, nonconcentration60sec. Both chosen-type immunity and50percent reflection remain. The five-type menu is an explicit local selection compatible with current Rebind, not a claim that Protection from Energy has only five types. One live Elemental Shell per recipient across casters; a later successful paid application replaces the old one atomically, with fresh ownership/deadline but no restoration of spent history.
selectedRules.authority: NEW spell-local authorship except explicit inherited KEEP and retained dependency

selectedRules.rule: For an incoming selected-element component at its ordinary defense stage, store basis after other eligible flat reductions, save scaling, resistance and independent immunities, immediately before this Shell own immunity. Reflection=floor(basis/2), exactly once. Even8->4, odd7->3, zero->0; an independent resistance7->3->1; independent immunity yields0. Shell own immunity then prevents the original selected component. If Rebind suppresses that immunity, the reflection benefit remains and actual incoming damage can also occur. Never reflect a mixed packet unsplit total or replay both a parent and its descendants.
selectedRules.authority: NEW spell-local authorship except explicit inherited KEEP and retained dependency

selectedRules.rule: Reflection automatically targets the actual responsible creature dealer, only if that extant creature is within120ft of the recipient and has a real unobstructed line of effect at resolution. No chosen substitute, inferred environmental owner, or controller substitution for a companion dealer. A dead, absent, out-of-range or blocked dealer receives no reflection; no bank. No attack roll, new critical doubling, attack-hit rider or retarget. Hidden dealer identity is retained privately without granting location knowledge. Area components preserve each original recipient; objects/environment with no creature dealer have no reflection target.
selectedRules.authority: NEW spell-local authorship except explicit inherited KEEP and retained dependency

selectedRules.rule: NEW exclude reflection-from-reflection. Emit at most one reflected component from this Shell per original selected incoming component/root, and no reflection on a post-defense transfer that bypasses the defense stage. Record consumed causal keys even after replacement/save-load. The reflected packet is new damage: new root, Shell bearer as dealer, parentRoot retained, new Null flag evaluated on that reflector at creation. Pure transfer descendants keep their parent flag and their single original-recipient sharing ledger. Reflected damage passes the actual recipient defenses once and can cause real HP/Wound/concentration outcomes; it does not inherit attack/critical or source on-hit grants. Reciprocal Shells may prevent reflected damage but emit no second reflection.
